channel.title: Wildcard Watch: Synology
channel.description: Exploited vulnerabilities and attacks involving Synology, each with its fix status and first step.

item.title: Patch now (update): Critical vulnerability in various versions of Synology BSM, DSM and DSMUC, could lead to remote code execution
item.description:
Synology BSM, DSM and DSMUC: RCE · exploited · fix available · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Install the security update for Synology BSM, DSM and DSMUC. The CCB advisories list the affected and fixed versions.

The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB) warns about this and advises to patch immediately. The CCB advisory lists the affected versions and the fix. The same day the CCB also warned: Critical vulnerabilities in Synology DiskStation Manager (DMS) enabling unauthorized data disclosure or denial-of-service (DoS).

Critical · Fix available
